title: The page table nobody builds

prereqs.why: It is one division and one multiplication, but only once you know what the table has one entry per.

statement:
A machine has a **1 GiB** virtual address space, **4 KiB** pages, and a page table that is a single flat array with **one 8-byte entry per page**.

How large is that table, in MiB?

Use binary units throughout: 1 GiB is 2^30 bytes, 1 KiB is 2^10, 1 MiB is 2^20.
hints: Work out how many pages the address space is divided into first. The entry size does not come into it until after that.
